title: Mongo-sharded: shard-primary failover (rs.stepDown) + per-shard RTO
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster mongo-sharded`: steps down the first data shard primary, measures the election RTO until a new primary appears in THAT shard, confirms the shard healed. --target picks a specific node or RS.

observe.what: original primary shard-1/<nodeA> -> new primary shard-1/<nodeB>; RTO timeline; recovery=recovered. Live: ~2.8s.
a different shard-1 member is PRIMARY; the stepped-down node is SECONDARY

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.FailoverAsync runs rs.stepDown(60) on the targeted shard primary (via __system on 127.0.0.1:27018) and measures a real per-shard election RTO; the other shards + config RS are unaffected.
